version.description: Configuration file format version (do not change unless instructed).

driver_method.description: Method for discovering and installing printer drivers.

auto_install.description: Allow automatic installation of missing proprietary drivers.

data_dir.description: Directory containing HPLIP data files (icons, PPDs, etc.).

run_dir.description: Directory for runtime files (e.g., lock files).

state_dir.description: Directory for user-specific state (e.g., device list, preferences).

check_update.description: Check online for HPLIP GUI updates at startup.

show_tray_icon.description: Display the HP tray icon in the system notification area.

tray_icon_delay.description: Seconds to wait after login before showing the tray icon (helps avoid desktop clutter).

scan_preview_enabled.description: Enable scan preview window in the GUI.

print_default_color.description: Print in color by default (vs. grayscale).

fax_enabled.description: Enable fax features in the HPLIP GUI (requires compatible device).

usb_poll_interval.description: USB device status polling interval in milliseconds (higher = less CPU usage).

usb_timeout.description: Timeout in seconds for USB operations (e.g., device discovery).

devices.description: List of manually configured or detected HP devices.

name.description: Unique internal identifier for this device (e.g., 'hp_laserjet' or 'deskjet_3700').

friendly_name.description: Human-readable name shown in the GUI.

device_uri.description: Device URI in HPLIP format (e.g., hp://usb, hp://net, hp://parallel).

model.description: Exact product model name (e.g., 'DeskJet 3755'). Optional but recommended.
